flashcard_questions.q: On what date did four Black students begin the sit-in at Woolworth's in Greensboro?

Which 1960 Supreme Court ruling banned segregation on interstate buses and in bus terminals?

Which Birmingham police commissioner ordered fire hoses and dogs against the marchers?
How many people gathered at the Lincoln Memorial for the March on Washington?
Which prize was Martin Luther King Jr. awarded in 1964?
What name was given to the attack on marchers at the Edmund Pettus Bridge on 7 March 1965?
Which phrase summed up Malcolm X's approach to winning Black rights?
On what date was Malcolm X assassinated in New York?
Who popularised the slogan 'Black Power' as leader of SNCC in 1966?
Which party did Huey Newton and Bobby Seale found in Oakland in October 1966?

On what date was Martin Luther King Jr. assassinated in Memphis?

notes: 15 cards: 5 event to date, 5 organisation-or-name, 3 person to significance, 1 statistic, 1 quotation. Dropped the Freedom Rides detail (Anniston, marshal numbers) to keep the deck inside 15 and avoid three near-identical 1961 fronts.
